necessary_context.content: B(a,s) is a closed geodesic ball. F_{kappa,r}^{xref}(M) consists of C-infinity real-valued functions on M for which there exist mu>0 and L with L/mu=kappa, Hess f(x) >= mu I for every x in M, ||Hess f(x)|| <= L on B(xref,r), and a unique global minimizer x* in B(xref,3r/4). Hadamard means complete, simply connected, and nonpositive sectional curvature everywhere.
necessary_context.locator: Definition 1, PDF pp.3–4; §2.1 and Definition 5, p.5; Definition 9, p.7
necessary_context.name: Function class and Hessian conventions

necessary_context.content: An Algorithm consists of x0 in M and arbitrary maps A_k:(R x TM)^k -> M. At step k it chooses x_k from the full preceding exact value and Riemannian gradient transcript. Queries may lie anywhere in M; no span restriction is imposed. Randomized Algorithms are not covered.
necessary_context.name: Deterministic first-order Algorithm model
